keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this means booking an external spa venue versus creating a DIY spa at home completely changes every step of the plan.
The daughter's age shapes which treatments are appropriate, how long the day should run, and what tone the experience should have.
The target date determines how much lead time is available for bookings, purchases, or invitations.
Budget sets the ceiling on venue quality, treatments, add-ons like meals or gifts, and DIY supply spending.
Knowing what types of treatments or activities both people enjoy (massages, facials, manicures, etc.) ensures the plan is tailored rather than generic.
Understanding the location or city helps identify real, bookable venues or local product sources rather than generic suggestions.
Clarifying the primary goal — deep relaxation, quality bonding time, a celebratory occasion, or a gift — defines what a great outcome actually looks like.

gold.taskDescription: Organise a relaxing spa day experience shared between a mother and daughter.

questions.title: Spa venue or DIY experience at home?
questions.description: Is the plan to book a professional spa, or to set up a spa experience at home?

questions.title: How old is the daughter?
questions.description: The daughter's age determines appropriate treatments, activity length, and overall tone of the day.

questions.title: What date or timeframe are you targeting?
questions.description: Knowing the intended date reveals how much planning time is available for bookings or preparation.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the day?
questions.description: Budget determines the tier of venue, number of treatments, meals, and any gift or keepsake elements.

questions.title: Which treatments do you both most enjoy?
questions.description: Preferred treatments such as massages, facials, manicures, or body wraps shape the core itinerary.

questions.title: What city or area are you located in?
questions.description: Location enables recommendations for real, bookable local venues or product suppliers.

questions.title: Is this tied to a special occasion or celebration?
questions.description: Knowing if this marks a birthday, graduation, holiday, or simply a bonding day shapes the tone and any celebratory extras.
